articles.headline: 2026 Ballon d'Or: Full men's, women's short lists, host city change, more
articles.description: The 2026 Ballon d'Or short lists are out. Here's who could win the biggest individual prizes in men's and women's soccer.

articles.headline: Cape Verde's Vozinha nominated for Goalkeeper of the Year award at Ballon d'Or after World Cup heroics
articles.description: Cape Verde goalkeeper Vozinha has been nominated for the men's Goalkeeper of the Year award at the 2026 Ballon d'Or.

articles.description: Gianni Infantino will run for reelection as FIFA president despite uncertainty over his future in the position following his failed attempt to raise $20 billion with the sale of a stake in future World Cups to private in

articles.headline: FIFA accuses UEFA of 'smear campaign' in opposing discovery request
articles.description: FIFA accused European soccer body UEFA of a "smear campaign" in a court filing Thursday concerning FIFA president Gianni Infantino's failed plan to sell stakes in the World Cup and other competitions.
